annotations.title: One-way ANOVA with Welch, Kruskal-Wallis and pairwise tests

description: One-way ANOVA with Welch, Kruskal-Wallis and pairwise tests — Compare means of 2-30 groups. groups= each group a comma list, groups separated by ; (required). Optional names= (comma group names), alpha=0.05. Returns the ANOVA table (SS, df, MS), F, p, eta and omega squared, Welch ANOVA (unequal variances), Brown-Forsythe/Levene variance test, Kruskal-Wallis H, and pairwise Welch t-tests with Holm-adjusted p-values, plus MEANS_DIFFER/NO_SIGNIFICANT_DIFFERENCE verdict. Offline; matches scipy f_oneway/kruskal/levene. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_anova
